title: Extract understand action Drive conversation exports

large_file_check.impact: Chat/connector cannot load this object directly; worker must use streaming download by Drive API media endpoint or split/export outside connector response limits.
workaround_steps: Use Drive file ID, not rendered webViewLink.
Call Drive files.get?alt=media with service/account credentials available to Pen worker.
Stream bytes to temp/S3/GitHub artefact without returning the full payload to chat.
Parse JSON incrementally using ijson/stream-json style parser.
Emit one analysis_template_v2 JSONL row per extracted page/thread/doc.
Write final receipt with counts and failed chunks.

execution_contract.evidence_policy: REAL runtime evidence required; PARTIAL if connector/chunk incomplete; PRETEND rejected

cycle_spec.goal: Inventory all visible Drive exports, verify access, capture file metadata, size, type, timestamps.
Stream parse JSON exports by file ID, extract URLs/docs/threads/code/assets/actions without loading full file into chat or memory.
Deduplicate by canonical URL/content hash/thread id; cluster by business/system/research/revenue/infra.
Apply analysis_template_v2 to every page/thread/doc; classify evidence REAL/PARTIAL/PRETEND.
Generate actionable outputs: tasks, owners, accountability, IP candidates, business candidates, enhancements, receipts.

acceptance_criteria: All seven visible Drive JSON files attempted and status recorded.
Large Claude JSON attempted via streaming media endpoint, not direct connector fetch.
Every extracted page/thread/doc receives analysis_template_v2 object or failed/private status with reason.
Duplicate groups and occurrence counts are produced.
Generated tasks include owner, system_layer, state, completion_criteria, evidence_required, retry_policy.
Receipt JSON includes input counts, processed counts, failed counts, output paths, runtime timestamp, evidence classification.
fallbacks: If streaming media endpoint fails, split source externally or mark file PARTIAL with BLOCKED:access_or_size and continue remaining files.
If Drive access fails, create PARTIAL receipt and mark missing file as BLOCKED:access.
If Supabase write unavailable, write JSON artefacts to GitHub receipts path first.
